status: locked before acquisition and final test
replications: one live acquisition per question/mode; five attacker seeds are computational repeats
cnn_selection: two prespecified candidates, train fit with group-heldout early stopping, select balanced accuracy; tie first; lock all choices before final test
primary_metric: max clipped normalised advantage across four attackers and three secrets; preserve per-secret and raw scores
chance: site-conditioned constant prior for link secrets; global for query family
comparison: live composition versus live single defences; best single chosen from select results, test reserved for final reporting; report no benefit if observed
budget_policy: no physical energy budget; observed byte ratios and execution windows only
contribution_label: maximum matching rows across actual calls, not unique union; first unflagged cohort call is a superset
query_correctness: full causal trace compared with independent local replay of real tables
test_rule: do not adjust workload, attack hyperparameters or transport parameters using final-test metrics; failed acquisition retained, revised protocol requires a fresh run
limitations: single-host synthetic data, overlapping cohorts across questions
bounded typed controller, not free-form autonomous planning
not measured energy, no hosted LLM or NetShaper
public start, model planning and summary outside observed execution window
OS scheduling and transport privacy not certified
one new holdout, small test size; not confirmatory paper evidence
